CodeMirror 6, bundled for LakeShark Studio into codemirror.js (one file, no network at run time).

Built from codemirror-entry.js with esbuild 0.25.0:
    npm install codemirror@6.0.2 @codemirror/lang-cpp @codemirror/autocomplete @codemirror/view @codemirror/state @codemirror/language @codemirror/lint @codemirror/commands @codemirror/search @lezer/highlight
    npx esbuild codemirror-entry.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --global-name=CM --outfile=codemirror.js

Packages in the bundle, all under the MIT licence below:
    @codemirror/autocomplete 6.20.4
    @codemirror/commands 6.11.1
    @codemirror/lang-cpp 6.0.3
    @codemirror/language 6.13.1
    @codemirror/lint 6.9.7
    @codemirror/search 6.7.2
    @codemirror/state 6.7.6
    @codemirror/view 6.43.15
    @lezer/common 1.5.5
    @lezer/cpp 1.1.6
    @lezer/highlight 1.2.5
    @lezer/lr 1.4.12
    crelt 1.0.7
    style-mod 4.1.4
    w3c-keyname 2.2.8
